en.summary: Overall market sentiment is largely [[pos:bullish in tech]], fueled by AI narratives, yet selective volatility exists. [[key:Implied Volatility (IV)]] is moderate to high across many names, creating attractive premiums for selling strategies. We see a split focus: continued strength in AI leaders like Amazon and Microsoft, alongside cautious positions in value and meme stocks. Top trade setups include a [[key:Sell Put]] on AMZN around $260, leveraging strong support and bullish sentiment. Conversely, a [[key:Sell Call]] on AMD at $400-$405 appears promising given high IV and price currently above resistance, anticipating a pullback. [[warn:Geopolitical risks]] and [[warn:upcoming earnings]] are key factors.
